judgments.label: uncertain
judgments.rationale: The element is the span.select2-selection__rendered that Select2 4.0.6-rc.0 puts inside its combobox for the Modalidade filter (role=textbox, read-only, title="Modalidade", text "Modalidade"). claimTrue: the CDP node in the snapshot has role textbox and name "" (title not used as name in Chromium, value "Modalidade"), so the claim about what the browser computes holds; its gloss overstates a little, since the value is exposed and would be read. elementFails: the span is not focusable or operable; the control users operate is the parent combobox, which is named through aria-labelledby ("Modalidade") and has a role and value, and by the accessible name computation the title attribute would name the span in other engines. But it is exposed as an unnamed textbox widget in Chromium, ARIA requires a name for textbox, and Select2 later dropped this role as a defect. Whether this inner span counts as a separate user interface component that fails 4.1.2 is something competent auditors would split on, so uncertain. The widget's more serious problem is elsewhere: the visually hidden <label for=select4> names only the aria-hidden native select, so the combobox is named by its current value. captureDiffers: the live HTML has the same select4 markup and loads the same Select2 4.0.6-rc.0, which builds the same span; no difference found.

judgments.label: true_positive
